summary: The most operationally significant development is the massive Russian missile strike on Kyivshchyna on September 19, 2026, which damaged nine civilian objects across four districts including major infrastructure. This followed earlier attacks on Odessa and continued drone activity across multiple Ukrainian regions. The campaign shows intensified Russian tactical air power targeting both urban centers and industrial sites.
key_points: Reactive drones from Odesa region were observed heading toward Ovidiopol via Black Sea aquifer corridor (Source: @kpszsu/78988)
Underground factory complex constructed in Alabuz for Shakhter drone production covering approximately 42,000 square meters (Source: @UkraineNow/84186)
On September 19, 2026 Russian forces launched a massive strike on Kyivshchyna infrastructure damaging nine civilian objects (Source: @eRadarrua/114401)
The attack destroyed five storage buildings, industrial facilities, transport networks, and a multi-apartment residential building (Source: @eRadarrua/114401)
Over fifty strikes were recorded in Kyivshchyna district alone within a single day following the main assault (Source: @eRadarrua/114401)
A child died in Sukhove on September 18 after a KAB bomb struck a residential building, killing both parents (Source: @eRadarrua/114431)
Three civilians were injured in an Odessa business-center attack on September 18, with a second attack occurring when rescue teams arrived (Source: @UkraineNow/84167)
